summary: Iteration 4 (custom doctor hours + patient profile + appointment reschedule) tested end-to-end. 43/44 backend tests PASS, 1 minor failure on legacy-doctor lunch fallback. Frontend: profile page save flow, reschedule modal flow, navbar 'My Profile' link, and AdminDashboard doctor form with all 5 new working-hour fields all verified working.

minor.issue: _generate_slots() in /app/backend/routes/doctors.py applies fallback defaults for start_time/end_time/slot_duration_minutes BUT NOT for lunch_start/lunch_end. Spec says: 'Legacy doctors must fall back to default 09:00-17:00 / 30min / 13:00-14:00 lunch.' Currently legacy seeded doctors return 13:00 and 13:30 as available slots (no lunch break). Fix: change `lunch_s = doc.get("lunch_start")` to `lunch_s = doc.get("lunch_start") or "13:00"` and same for lunch_end -> "14:00" (only when both start_time/end_time also missing, OR globally - per spec, globally).

action_items: Fix legacy lunch fallback in /app/backend/routes/doctors.py::_generate_slots so seeded doctors (no lunch fields) skip 13:00-14:00 by default per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/auth/profile correctly uses Pydantic ProfileUpdate (only name/phone/address) - any 'email' field sent is silently dropped (extra='ignore' default) - email is structurally locked. Good.

PUT /api/appointments/{id}/reschedule correctly: (a) blocks past slots via datetime comparison, (b) excludes self in clash query via $ne ObjectId, (c) gates on status in (confirmed, pending_payment), (d) admin bypass works. Verified all 6 paths.
Reschedule endpoint uses datetime.now() (naive local) instead of datetime.now(timezone.utc) - works in container but inconsistent with rest of codebase. Minor.
_generate_slots() falls back start/end/duration to defaults but NOT lunch — single-line fix needed (see backend_issues.minor).
ProfilePage UX: shows 'Profile updated successfully' toast on save, email field rendered with disabled+'Locked' badge. Excellent.

RescheduleModal: opens cleanly, calendar (shadcn) renders, confirms inline without page reload (verified data-testid='reschedule-modal' + 'reschedule-calendar' + 'reschedule-confirm'). 'reschedule-slots-grid' only renders AFTER a date is selected (lazy) - this is correct behaviour, not a bug.

AdminDashboard doctor form correctly exposes all 5 new fields (doctor-form-start_time, end_time, slot_duration, lunch_start, lunch_end) with sensible defaults pre-filled. Edit existing doctor reuses same form.
Navbar 'nav-profile' testid lives inside Radix dropdown content (mounted on open) — works correctly, just requires opening the user-menu trigger first.

rca_of_the_issue: Legacy lunch fallback bug — RCA: doctors collection seeded by /app/backend/seed.py predates iteration-4 fields. _generate_slots() reads lunch_start/lunch_end via doc.get(...) WITHOUT a fallback string, so when None they evaluate falsy and the if-branch skips lunch entirely. Fix: `lunch_s = doc.get('lunch_start') or '13:00'` (and same for end). Reproduction: GET /api/doctors -> pick non-TEST seeded doctor -> GET /api/doctors/{id}/available-slots?date=<future> -> response includes '13:00' and '13:30' which violates spec. Mitigation: one-line fallback OR a one-shot DB migration to backfill the fields onto existing doctor docs. Recommended: code fallback (zero-downtime) AND optional migration.
